text_block_list.name: Petelgeuse
text_block_list.text: Curse you, curse you... Curse you, curse you, curse you!!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
おのれおのれぇ……
オノレオノレオノレェェ！！

text_block_list.name: Ram
text_block_list.text:
This seems to be working.
Well then, let me follow up with my magic!
text_block_list.orig_text:
さすがに効いているようね。
なら、
ラムの魔法で追撃を……！

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text:
Wait a moment, sister!
The Witch's lingering scent is suddenly growing more potent!
text_block_list.orig_text:
待ってください、
姉様！
魔女の残り香が
急に濃くなってきています！

text_block_list.name: Petelgeuse
text_block_list.text:
I cannot perishhhh... I cannot perish here!
I must repay her love!
For the Witch, the Witch, the Witch, the Witch, the Witch!!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
終われナイィィィィ……
終われナイノデス！！
寵愛に報いなケレバァ！
魔女に
魔女に魔女ニ魔女ニ魔女ニィィィッ！！

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: O-oh, no! His Unseen Hands are going wild!
text_block_list.orig_text:
き、
急に
『見えざる手』の勢いが……！

text_block_list.name: Ram
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps he's preparing a last-ditch plan...
Only a fool would charge in head-first.
text_block_list.orig_text:
なにか仕掛けてくるかもしれないわね……
無策で飛び込むのは危険よ。

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text:
And yet we cannot keep our distance, either!
What now...?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ですが、
近づかないわけにもいきません。
どうすれば……

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: It's okay. I know how we can deal with this!
text_block_list.orig_text:
大丈夫、
なんとかする方法ならあるわ！

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: Miss Emilia? You have some kind of plan?
text_block_list.orig_text:
エミリア様、
なにか策があるのですか？

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text:
We just have to defeat him
before his Unseen Hands can reach us!
See? Very simple, isn't it?
text_block_list.orig_text:
『見えざる手』につかまる前に、
大罪司教を倒せばいいの！
ね、
すごーく簡単でしょ？

text_block_list.name: Ram
text_block_list.text:
...I have many things I could say to that,
but I suppose it's the best plan we've got.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……色々と言いたいことはあるけれど、
現状ではそれしかなさそうね。

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: Then allow me to forge a path to the Sin Archbishop!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ならばレムが、
大罪司教までの道を切り開きます！
